in_marathi.name: Ekambar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the five elements
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekambar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekambar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'eka' meaning one and 'ambar' meaning sky or Lord of the five elements. The name is believed to be derived from the five elements of earth, water, fire, air, and space, which are collectively known as 'Panchabhoota' in Hinduism.
